LobbySlot.title: LobbySlot
LobbySlot.description: Points a public parlor table slot to the currently active Match document ID for real-time player matchmaking.

slotId.description: Identifier of the parlor table slot (e.g., slot-1, slot-2, slot-3, slot-4).

activeMatchId.description: Document ID of the current active match in the matches collection.

updatedBy.description: UID of the authenticated user who last updated this table pointer.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the pointer update.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Real-time two-player match lobby and game state for Three Hats & A Coin.

hostId.description: UID of the player who created the match lobby.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the match. Terminal when finished.

player1Id.description: UID of the player who picked 1st Player (or empty string if unclaimed).

player1Name.description: Display nickname of 1st Player (or empty string if unclaimed).

player2Id.description: UID of the player who picked 2nd Player (or empty string if unclaimed).

player2Name.description: Display nickname of 2nd Player (or empty string if unclaimed).

hiderSlot.description: Which player is hiding the coin behind the blanket this round (1 or 2).

coinHat.description: Hat index where the coin is hidden (-1 while unchosen, 0, 1, or 2).

guessedHat.description: Hat index guessed by the Seeker (-1 while unchosen, 0, 1, or 2).

lastRoundWinnerSlot.description: Player slot (0, 1, or 2) that won the most recent point.

winnerSlot.description: Player slot (0, 1, or 2) that reached 5 points and won the match.

/lobbySlots/{slotId}.description: Public parlor table pointers to active match IDs.

/matches/{matchId}.description: Real-time multiplayer match lobby and round state documents.
